title: Test Plan — Get an AI Test Plan for a Product
purpose: Test Plan uses AI to suggest the tests a product needs, based on its description, import country, intended users and photos. You open it from a product's Quality Requirement tab.
meta: Product Management → product profile → Quality Requirement
https://qmas.icw.io/product/list → click a product → Quality Requirement → Test Plan
[[guide:product-profile|Product Management — Every Tab of the Product Profile]]
overview: Open a product and go to **Quality Requirement**.
Fill in the product information and upload photos.

body: On **Product Management**, click a product to open its profile. In the left menu, click **Quality Requirement**, then click **Test Plan** next to the title.

list: **Product Description** (required): describe the product. More detail gives better results. QMAS fills in the product name for you.
**Import Country** (required): where the product will be sold.
**Product Intended Used By** (required): who the product is for.
**Product Images (Multiple Views)** (required): upload up to 6 photos (PNG, JPEG, JPG, WEBP, GIF, AVIF or HEIC).

body.caption: Test Plan pop-up.
body.alt: Test Plan pop-up with Product Description, Import Country, Product Intended Used By, product image upload and Generate Test Plan.

body: Click **Generate Test Plan**. To add tests as quality requirements, use **Add Requirement** or a template on the same Quality Requirement tab.

tips: Give a detailed product description, including materials, age grade and functions, for a more accurate plan.
faq: Open a product → Quality Requirement → Test Plan.
What do I need to generate a test plan?
A product description, the import country, who the product is intended for, and product photos.
